ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation on the left lobe with isolated high-intensity circular nodes at the base; extensive high-intensity white mottling and confluent patches localized in the central and lateral regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 50 degrees and a deep vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Fine-grain serrations along the trailing edge of the left lobe; more pronounced, irregular jagged peaks and valleys on the trailing edge of the right lobe, specifically in the upper quadrant.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex posterior edges sweeping upward toward the distal tips, terminating in irregular biological protrusions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct high-contrast circular rings (rosette scars) visible on the lower medial portion of the left lobe; dense clusters of irregular white spots on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, near-vertical high-contrast linear marks (scratches) present on the lower portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive clusters of stalked and acorn barnacles attached to the distal tips of both fluke lobes, creating highly irregular, non-biological silhouettes at the extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe displays a significantly higher density of white depigmentation/mottling compared to the left lobe, which remains predominantly dark.
